pages.title: Three kinds of asceticism
paragraphs: *There are three kinds of asceticism*

Spiritual or mental – its aim is to discipline the development of thought,
Soul or astral – its aim is the ennobling of the soul, the instinctive mastery of the passions,
Bodily or material – a moderate, harmonious way of life.
Without these three kinds of asceticism, which must be practiced and developed at the same time, true Táltos ascension is unthinkable.
Many religious people try to be good in order to escape hell, that is, out of fear.
A person of the Táltos faith does so in order to ennoble their soul and spirit. This is the path of spiritual nobility.
*Only in an ennobled soul can the universal laws take effect.* This is especially true when body, soul and spirit are trained equally.

pages.title: Practice
paragraphs: In practice it is very important to keep to the principle of gradualness. Haste is not advisable, because it can lead to relapse.
Whoever steps onto the Táltos path has a sacred duty to practice!

Let us always be friendly, helpful and forgiving towards our fellow human beings! Towards ourselves, however, let us be hard and never forgiving! We may never criticize others; let us sweep only in front of our own door!

pages.title: Practice
paragraphs: Let us divide our time and decide how much of it we devote to ascension. There is no need to sit for hours over a bottle of beer, spending our time in empty company! Let us set a length of time, and let us keep to it! After a while we will long for the exercises.
*No diligence, no reward!*
Practice is the high school of humility! Silence greatly helps development. *Silence is golden!*

gate.timeQuote: Let us set a length of time, and let us keep to it!

gondolat.title: Thought observation
paragraphs: The exercise is to be done in the morning and in the evening.
Make yourself comfortable and close your eyes! Watch the course of your thoughts for five minutes! Be a silent observer!
At first the thoughts will circle around the day’s worries, tasks and work. What matters is that we observe the course of the thoughts! If we are tired, we should rather stop.
Every day let us increase the time given to the exercise by one minute; after a week we can already hold ten-minute exercises.
*By no means should we move on to the second exercise until we have fully mastered the first!*
At first it will be hard to remember the many thoughts. Later fewer and fewer thoughts will arise.

fegyelmezes.title: Thought discipline
paragraphs: Once we have learned to check our thoughts, *mental training* can follow.
Thoughts that are unwanted and yet persistently surface in us again and again: let us not allow them to remain in our spirit!
*Let us get used to doing everything we do with full attention!*
We will be able to fix a single thought or a single idea for a longer time, and firmly suppress other unwanted thoughts that want to join in or force their way forward!
Every thought that is not connected to the exercise must be rejected. We must reach the point where we can follow and hold a single train of thought for ten minutes.

uresseg.title: Emptiness of thought
paragraphs: *The next step: complete emptiness of thought, or rather creating it.*

Let us energetically reject every thought during the exercise. Let us hold the emptiness without drifting off, forgetting ourselves or falling asleep. At first we will manage this for a few seconds, then gradually we will reach ten minutes.
Let us record success and failure in a Táltos diary!

onvizsgalat.title: Self-knowledge
paragraphs: *Without self-knowledge there is no true ascension!*

In our diary let us write down all the bad sides of our soul: our faults, habits, passions, instincts and other less beautiful traits of character. Let us be hard and strict with ourselves in self-examination! Let us write down every weakness; the more we write down, the better! Let nothing remain hidden.
Self-analysis is the most important magical preparatory work.
Let us practice self-criticism every day and put it on paper. … Let us try to attribute every fault to one of the four elements.
Let us divide the recorded faults into three groups: the coarsest ones; the rarer, smaller ones; and the very rare, tiny things and faults.
Proceed in the same way with your good qualities.
With this work we also obtain two astral soul mirrors, a black one and a white one: one reflects our good qualities, the other our bad ones. This helps us find out which element is dominant in us.

test.title: Training the body
paragraphs: *Hand in hand with the training of the spirit and the soul must go the development and care of the body!*

In the morning let us brush and rub down our whole body so that the pores open; this relieves the kidneys! Let us wash at least our upper body with cold water! It will be refreshing and will banish tiredness. Let us do a few minutes of exercise every morning!

legzes.title: Breathing
paragraphs: Air consists of oxygen and nitrogen. Oxygen belongs to the Fire element, nitrogen to the Water element. The Air element is the mediator, the Earth element the binder. The fifth is the cause, or the God principle.

In conscious breathing we can place a thought or idea onto the air we breathe in (directly or figuratively); this is impregnated air. Through it the idea enters the blood via the lungs, and then reaches the spirit through the astral and mental bodies.
Many people have already ruined their health with radical breathing exercises, but the magical key is placing the thought or idea onto the inhaled air.
Táltos initiation is part of the universal system. Here what matters is not the quantity of the inhaled air but its quality, that is, the idea you place into the substance of the air.

Let us imagine that with the inhaled air, health, calm, peace, success – and everything we most wish to achieve – passes through the lungs and the blood into our body. The imagined idea must be so intense that the air we breathe in together with the wish is impregnated in such a way that this wish immediately becomes reality. We must not doubt this in the slightest!

It is enough to begin the exercises with 7 breaths each in the morning and in the evening. Let us increase the number by one breath each day, but it is not worth going beyond ten minutes. Here too the basic principle applies: never hurry! Let us begin with another wish only once the first has been fulfilled!
It is wise to choose wishes that are not selfish, but rather such as calm, peace, success.

etkezes.title: Conscious taking of food
paragraphs: The principle here is the same as with the air. The wish placed into the food (in Hungarian *óhaj*: Ó = the universe, spirit; Haj = energy) acts strongly on the material plane, since food is exposed to the coarsest elemental radiation.

Let us sit down at a plate full of food and concentrate with the most intense imagination we are capable of. Our wish becomes embodied in the food, and it will act as if the wish had already been realized. We can hold our hands towards the food, close our eyes or fix our gaze. Let us take in the food slowly, aware that with the eating our wish goes into our body, down to the finest nerves.

What communion is for Christians, taking food is for us: a sacred act. Every food and drink is suitable for Táltos magical impregnation with thought. We must eat everything; nothing may remain on the plate. If possible, let us not read or talk while eating, but concentrate the whole time on holding our wish!

It is important that no opposing wishes join our thoughts. If we wished for health in conscious breathing, we must not concentrate on something else while eating, for example on success. *Whoever chases two hares at once catches neither.*
The words of Christ will become clear to us: *“Take, eat; this is my body. Drink ye all of it, for this is my blood!”*

viz.title: The magic of water
paragraphs: One of the main properties of the Water element is magnetism, the power of attraction. Water can be magnetized, filled with Od. Every liquid has the special capacity of attraction and, through contraction, of holding fast.
The colder the water, the better suited it is to accumulation. At 36–37 °C water becomes neutral for magnetism.
Impregnation with thought, by contrast, is possible at any temperature, because here we use not the magnetic property but the fifth element, the primordial principle.

Every time we wash our hands, let us think that we are washing off not only the dirt from the body, but also, for example, failure, restlessness, dissatisfaction, illness. Let us imagine that our weaknesses, too, flow down the drain with the running water.
The method also works the other way round: before washing we impregnate the water with our thought, and while washing we become soaked with it.
We can also combine the two exercises: first we wash off, washing away the unwanted things, then we wash in other water that we have impregnated beforehand with our thought.

stages.name: Thought observation
stages.how: Make yourself comfortable and close your eyes. Watch the course of your thoughts. Be a silent observer!
stages.question: Did you stay a silent observer throughout, following the course of your thoughts?

stages.name: Thought discipline
stages.how: You follow and hold a single train of thought. You reject every other thought that tries to push in.
stages.question: Were you able to hold the one train of thought?

stages.name: Emptiness of thought
stages.how: You energetically reject every thought and hold the emptiness, without drifting off or falling asleep.
stages.question: Were you able to hold the emptiness, without drifting off or falling asleep?
stages.done: You have mastered emptiness of thought.

body.kefeles: Brushing and rubbing down the body
body.hideg_viz: Cold water wash (at least the upper body)

feher.tuz: enthusiastic, brave, ready to act, generous

sleep: Let us always fall asleep with thoughts of peace, contentment and health.

items.name: Focus and counterpart
items.text: At the start of the grade you choose the strongest black traits from your mirror, each with its counterpart. Every evening the focus card comes before the full list.

items.name: Autosuggestion
items.text: Before falling asleep and on waking you say the sentence of your wish 40 times, in the present tense (“I am calm.”). A new sentence comes only once the previous one has been fulfilled.

items.name: Projection with open eyes
items.text: The object floats in the air, for 5 minutes. Opens after the previous one.

items.name: Sound, feeling, scent, taste
items.text: One after another, each for 5 minutes, without an image.

items.name: A method for the focus
items.text: The three methods of the book: autosuggestion, transmutation, care and willpower.

items.name: Pore breathing
items.text: Breathing in, the wish comes in; breathing out, the weakness leaves.

items.name: Conscious posture
items.text: Sitting motionless: it starts with 5 minutes, 1 minute more each day, up to 30 minutes.

items.name: Mastering the body
items.text: A small daily task: one more short walk when tired, putting off a meal, slowing down when rushing.

fokozatok.theme: Multi-sense concentration · element breathing · vital force

items.name: Concentration with 2–3 senses
items.text: A ticking pendulum clock, a man striking a gong, a babbling brook, a wheat field in the wind.

items.name: Landscapes, rooms, animals, people
items.text: With eyes closed, then open. Opens after the previous one.

items.name: Element breathing
items.text: Fire, Air, Water, Earth: one element at a time. It starts with 7 breaths, and at the end you give it back with as many exhales. Prerequisite: no element should dominate in your mirror.

items.name: Accumulating vital force
items.text: First the whole body, then the parts of the body. Giving it back at the end is mandatory.

items.name: Impregnating a space
items.text: Filling the room with health and calm.
